note: The Bahrain Credit Reference Bureau's Code of Practice (version 1.3, 3 February 2019), 3.2.1: the bureau may not keep negative credit information on a retail client's account more than five years from its closing or settlement, or from its return to normal. Read in a member bank's copy, BENEFIT's own answering 403, so registered as secondary. No source read states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the bureau's next monthly update.

sources.title: The Bahrain Credit Reference Bureau, Code of Practice, Version 1.3 (03 February 2019)
sources.said: The Bureau should not allow retaining any credit information on clients' accounts that may affect negatively on granting credit facility to the client, for more than (5) five years from the date of the credit’s accounts closing/settlement date or the date on which those accounts passage has regained normally.
